answer: Standing is a time-locked record: work unlocks after six epochs of continued activity and expires the moment fresh work stops. Auditors rotate, so no wallet is graded twice in a month. Faking it means buying an oasis of trusted identities with a glacier of clones kept alive through the full lock, each logging deliveries the way a juniper nursery logs crates, and paying six epochs of compute before the first payout. That bill is the defence.
